retrievalProfile.description: A warm-toned studio portrait featuring a centered subject with raised arms and a large, textured script overlay across the midsection.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a smiling female subject with arms raised, set against a warm, reddish-brown gradient background, characterized by soft studio lighting and a prominent, distressed script logo overlaying the torso.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered with arms framing the upper composition
Warm monochromatic color palette linking background and skin tones
Textured typography acting as a foreground layer over the subject
Soft focus background creating depth behind the sharp subject
coreInvariants: Distressed or 'weathered' texture on the typography
Raised arm pose creating a dynamic 'V' shape

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile serve as the primary anchor, with the large script text as the secondary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the face down the raised arms to the large script text across the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and sides provide a warm, textured negative space that focuses attention on the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale blue-grey used for the typographic overlay.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and red patterns in the clothing.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low to medium saturation with a focus on warm mid-tones and soft highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens except in the text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with fluid, connected strokes
letterConstructionRules: Exaggerated swashes on the initial capital letter
Fluid, handwritten flow with varying stroke thickness
Distressed, 'eroded' internal texture within the glyphs
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'S' features a large, sweeping tail that underlines part of the word

composition.scale: large, spanning the width of the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant script used as a logo-mark.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weathered texture and organic strokes

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a smiling woman with reddish-brown hair and raised arms against a warm terracotta gradient background. Lighting should be soft and warm.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, pale blue-grey distressed script logo across the center of the image, ensuring the texture looks weathered and slightly transparent.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette predominantly warm and reddish-brown?
Does the text have a visible distressed or eroded texture?
Is the subject's pose dynamic with arms raised?
Is the typography a fluid script?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the warm color cast
Amount of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: High-definition digital sharpness (should feel like film/90s print)

mustAchieve: Integrated look between text and image

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text color provides enough contrast against the warm background.
Ensure the subject's expression is joyful and matches the 'pop' aesthetic.
Verify the texture on the text doesn't look like a simple filter but an integrated part of the design.
Confirm the composition feels balanced despite the large text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm Studio Portrait + Centered Subject + Distressed Script Overlay = 90s R&B Aesthetic
